integrity: The proof is written directly for truncated-poset downsets. A standalone Python 3 exact finite checker enumerates literal weights and separately reduces low-degree simplicial boundaries over F_2. Infinite-parameter and integral assertions rest on the written graph-quotient proof, not finite tests.
scientific_limitations: The homotopy classification is only for the early window t<binomial(r+2,r)+1, with r>=2, n>r, and r<=k<n; the all-time barcode claim is limited to H_0. No all-time positive-degree classification or uniqueness against unindexed literature is claimed.
title: Early homotopy and complete degree-zero furtherness persistence of upper-truncated Boolean posets
